result.stdout:
OfficeEditor CLI - Unified Office Document Editor

Usage:
  officeeditor create <output.file> [--type docx|pptx|xlsx] [--text "content"] 
[--title "title"] [--sheet "name"]
  officeeditor generate <input.json> [--output 
<output.pptx|output.docx|output.xlsx>] [--theme <name>]
  officeeditor detect <template.file>
  officeeditor merge <template.file> <data.json> <output.file>

generate options:
  --output <path>  Output file. Extension selects the format 
(.pptx|.docx|.xlsx);
                   defaults to <input.json> with a .pptx extension.
  --theme <name>   DOCX only: named design theme to apply (editorial|corporate).

Supported formats: .docx (Word), .pptx (PowerPoint), .xlsx (Excel)
Format is auto-detected from file extension.
